artifacts.summary: Identifies multi-task-creation-standard.md as the single reference point for a new consolidation-vs-division test; documents the gap in task.md's Create and Expand modes, /meta and /fix-it's fuzzy clustering, and /errors' total absence of grouping; confirms the motivating incident (task 289) was a correctly-resolved near-miss.

memory_candidates.content: This repo's multi-task-creation-standard.md is the single shared reference every multi-task creator (/meta, /fix-it, /errors, /task --review) already points to by path. When adding a new cross-cutting rule for task creation, add it there once and have consumers reference it, rather than editing each command file separately -- matches the existing convention.

task.md's --expand mode (context/standards/task-management.md) documents an inline creation-time division variant delegating to a 'task-divider' component, but no such agent or skill file exists anywhere in agent-system/extensions/core -- this is stale/aspirational documentation, not implemented prior art. Verify referenced delegation targets actually exist in the source store before citing them as existing mechanisms.
